entities.summary: Switzerland is a sovereign nation in Western Europe, Europe. Its capital is Bern (de facto; no official capital). Official languages include German, French, Italian. Government: Federal semi-direct democracy under multi-party directorial republic. Population: approximately 8.9 million. Area: 41,285 km². historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Switzerland's federal semi-direct democracy and neutrality during WWII had a significant impact on European politics, with its perpetual neutrality recognized by the Congress of Vienna in 1815. This legacy continues to shape its international relations and domestic governance.
